children.text: atharvāṇam ṛṣiṃ devaṃ devahayaśirodharam |
children.translated_text: Having bowed to the sage <s>Atharvāṇa</s>, the divine one who bears the head of the celestial horse,

children.text: praṇamya sampravakṣyāmi dantyoṣṭhavidhivistaram || 1.1 ||
children.translated_text: I shall expound in detail the rules of dental and labial [pronunciation]. || 1.1 ||

children.text: chandasy adhyayane prāpte viduṣām atha dhīmatām |
children.translated_text: When the study of Vedic meters commences, among the learned and wise,

children.text: bakāre saṃśayo nityam auṣṭhyaṃ dantyam iti sma ha || 1.2 ||
children.translated_text: there is always doubt regarding the 'ba'-sound — whether it is labial or dental. || 1.2 ||

children.text: tasmāt tadvidhi nirṇaye saṃśayachedanāya ca |
children.translated_text: Therefore, for determining that rule and for removing doubt,

children.text: muktā dantyā prayojyāma auṣṭhyān vakṣye kramāhitaḥ || 1.3 ||
children.translated_text: having set aside the labials, I shall state where the dentals are to be employed, in due order. || 1.3 ||

children.text: bhaparaṃ yatra dṛśyetāniṃgye sparśanaṃ kva cit |
children.translated_text: Where a 'bha'-following [consonant] is seen, and in some cases a nasal contact,

children.text: auṣṭyaṃ tatra pade dhīro bibhīto bibhratīr yathā || 1.4 ||
children.translated_text: there a wise person [should use] the labial pronunciation in that word, as in 'bibhīta' and 'bibhratīḥ.' || 1.4 ||

children.text: ādyudātte bale bāṇe bila śabde tathaiva ca |
children.translated_text: In [words with] initial <s>udātta</s> (acute accent), in 'bala' (strength), 'bāṇa' (arrow), and likewise in the word 'bila' (hole),

children.text: samaste 'pi yatra syātām antodātto viśiṣyate || 1.5 ||
children.translated_text: even in compound forms wherever they occur, the <s>anudātta</s> (grave accent) ending is distinguished. || 1.5 ||

children.text: baladābalānugrāhabaladhanvā tathaiva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Baladā,' 'balānugrāha,' 'baladhanvā,' and likewise

children.text: balāsaṃ bāhū ācāryāḥ sarvāsv eva vibhaktiṣu || 1.6 ||
children.translated_text: 'balāsa' and 'bāhū' — the teachers [declare these labial] in all case-forms. || 1.6 ||

children.text: balī balena barhiś cābalena balīyase |
children.translated_text: 'Balī,' 'balena,' and 'barhiḥ,' 'abalena,' 'balīyase,'

children.text: bradhnaḥ kilbiṣaṃ vaḥ ketuḥ kumbaṃ bādhiṣṭa bāliti || 1.7 ||
children.translated_text: 'bradhna,' 'kilbiṣa,' 'vaḥ,' 'ketu,' 'kumba,' 'bādhiṣṭa,' 'bāla' — thus [these are labial]. || 1.7 ||

children.text: bāhuṃ bohi tathā baṃdhur bahubādhe bṛhac ca yat |
children.translated_text: 'Bāhu,' 'bohi,' likewise 'bandhur,' 'bahubādhe,' and whatever is 'bṛhat,'

children.text: pibati bruvate caiva yathārthāḥ samprakīrttitāḥ || 1.8 ||
children.translated_text: 'pibati' and 'bruvate' — these have been duly proclaimed according to their meanings. || 1.8 ||

children.text: bastavāsino bāhvaṃkair bāhuvīrye tathaiva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Bastavāsina,' 'bāhvaṅkaiḥ,' and likewise 'bāhuvīrye,'

children.text: bahavaḥ kābavaṃ bāhvor bodha bahve tathaiva ca || 1.9 ||
children.translated_text: 'bahavaḥ,' 'kābava,' 'bāhvoḥ,' 'bodha,' and likewise 'bahve.' || 1.9 ||

children.text: tathāa badhnyaṃ tābuvaṃ bahvīr navamaḥ saṃprakīrttitāḥ |
children.translated_text: Also 'badhnya,' 'tābuva,' and 'bahvīḥ' — [these] nine have been proclaimed.

children.text: ete sarveṣu śabdeṣu prathamasparśyā hi matāḥ || 1.10 ||
children.translated_text: All these are considered to have the first contact [i.e., labial] in all [these] words. || 1.10 ||

children.text: vaibādha devabandhuṃ ca vibaddhas tu vibandhuṣu |
children.translated_text: 'Vaibādha,' 'devabandhu,' and 'vibaddha,' and in 'vibandhu' —

children.text: dvitīya sparśyo vijñeyo vibabādhe tathaiva ca || 1.11 ||
children.translated_text: the second contact [i.e., dental] should be recognized, and likewise in 'vibabādhe.' || 1.11 ||

children.text: bāhau bāhavo bahulaṃ budhnyaṃ baddhkam eva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Bāhau,' 'bāhavaḥ,' 'bahula,' 'budhnya,' and 'baddhaka' also —

children.text: ete sarve bhavanty oṣṭhyā ye noktās te tu dantajāḥ || 1.12 ||
children.translated_text: all these are labial; those not mentioned [as labial] are dental. || 1.12 ||

children.text: adharād uttare bhāge bhāgāt prativibhāgaśaḥ |
children.translated_text: From the lower [lip] to the upper part, portion by portion in succession,

children.text: daśanāgreṇa saṃspṛṣṭyo na tu pīḍāsu yojayet || 2.1 ||
children.translated_text: touching with the tip of the teeth — but one should not apply pressure. || 2.1 ||

children.text: kambalaṃ balbajaṃ bījaṃ libujā baṇmhāṃ asi |
children.translated_text: 'Kambala,' 'balbaja,' 'bīja,' 'libujā,' 'baṇmhāṃ asi,'

children.text: biṣkale brahma barjahye śabale bedhiṣe bayaḥ || 2.2 ||
children.translated_text: 'biṣkala,' 'brahma,' 'barjahya,' 'śabala,' 'bedhiṣe,' 'bayaḥ.' || 2.2 ||

children.text: bahiṣṭhaḥ budhnyaḥ paḍbīśam arbudaṃ badhiras tathā |
children.translated_text: 'Bahiṣṭha,' 'budhnya,' 'paḍbīśa,' 'arbuda,' and likewise 'badhira,'

children.text: ābayobinduḥ saṃbiṃbaṃ kāhābām udumbalam || 2.3 ||
children.translated_text: 'ābaya,' 'bindu,' 'saṃbimba,' 'kāhābām,' 'udumbala.' || 2.3 ||

children.text: kabru pībasi baṃdhuraṃ kaṃbūkāṃ balinas tathā |
children.translated_text: 'Kabru,' 'pībasi,' 'bandhura,' 'kambūkā,' and likewise 'balinā,'

children.text: kuberaḥ stambajaṃ babhraupabdaiḥ paribedhire || 2.4 ||
children.translated_text: '<s>Kubera</s>,' 'stambaja,' 'babhru,' 'upadaiḥ,' 'paribedhire.' || 2.4 ||

children.text: asaṃbādhe nairbādhyena baddhe buddhāni kulbajaṃ |
children.translated_text: 'Asambādhe,' 'nairbādhyena,' 'baddhe,' 'buddhāni,' 'kulbaja,'

children.text: bato batāsi bandhuṃ ca bisaṃ klībaṃ buje bujaḥ || 2.5 ||
children.translated_text: 'bata,' 'batāsi,' 'bandhu,' and 'bisa,' 'klība,' 'buje,' 'bujaḥ.' || 2.5 ||

children.text: badhāna prābaṃdhāyāś colbaṃ kāberkas tathā |
children.translated_text: 'Badhāna,' 'prābandhāyāḥ,' 'ulba,' and likewise 'kāberka,'

children.text: ābedhur ailabaś caivābedhe balhikāni ca || 2.6 ||
children.translated_text: 'ābedhur,' 'ailaba,' and also 'ābedhe' and 'balhikāni.' || 2.6 ||

children.text: abodhi bārhatsāme ghoṣabuddhā tathaiva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Abodhi,' 'bārhatsāme,' and likewise 'ghoṣabuddhā,'

children.text: baṃdhanaṃ yatra śeṣaṃ syād ābadhe me nidraśanam || 2.7 ||
children.translated_text: wherever 'bandhana' remains, 'ābadhe me' [is given] as an illustration. || 2.7 ||

children.text: alābu bajaḥ bāṇaṃ syād ādyudātto yadā bhavet |
children.translated_text: 'Alābu,' 'bajaḥ,' and 'bāṇa' — when there is an initial <s>udātta</s> (acute accent),

children.text: brahma śabdaṃ tu sarvārtham auṣṭhyam eva vidur budhāḥ || 2.8 ||
children.translated_text: the word 'brahma' in all its meanings is known by the wise to be labial. || 2.8 ||

children.text: chubukābdaṣkaye bāle keśabāle tathaiva ca |
children.translated_text: 'Chubuka,' 'abdaṣkaye,' in 'bāle' [meaning young], and likewise in 'keśabāle,'

children.text: adhibāle vayaḥ proktaḥ śeṣeṣu parimāṇataḥ || 2.9 ||
children.translated_text: in 'adhibāle' the meaning is stated as age, and in the rest by measure. || 2.9 ||

children.text: bibhed ādiṣu bhedāś ca pari pūrvaṃ bale tathā |
children.translated_text: 'Bibheda' and others, and also 'bheda' — with 'pari' as prefix and 'bala' likewise,

children.text: baṃdhu vā siṃdhurapara eteṣāṃ tu balaḥ kva cit || 2.10 ||
children.translated_text: 'bandhu' or 'sindhur' and the rest — among these 'bala' [is dental] in some cases. || 2.10 ||

children.text: tuchubdaś cubukaś caiva babhūvuś ca babhūvuṣī |
children.translated_text: 'Tuchubda' and 'cubuka,' and 'babhūvuḥ' and 'babhūvuṣī' —

children.text: ete sarve parityajya bakāronyonya bhakṣana || 2.11 ||
children.translated_text: all these, setting aside the 'ba'-sound, mutually consume [i.e., interchange with] one another. || 2.11 ||

body.translated_text: || The <s>Dantyoṣṭhavidhi</s> (Rules of Dental and Labial Pronunciation) is complete. ||
